name: daylight
lore:
### *Daylight: The Anchored Dawn*

To cast *Daylight* is to briefly usurp the sky. Unlike the flickering uncertainty of a torch, this spell manifests as a sphere of unwavering, golden brilliance. It emanates from the chosen focus—be it a blade’s pommel or a simple stone—piercing even the most stubborn supernatural glooms with the authority of high noon.

When shaping the Weave for this incantation, an initiate will feel a sudden, heavy warmth suffusing their palms. It is as if one is knitting together threads of molten honey; the magic hums with a resonant, celestial pressure that settles deep in the marrow.

**The Legend of the Gilded Sigh**
Scholars attribute its discovery to Saint Elara the Sightless during the *Age of Ash*. Trapped within the abyssal gullet of the Underdark, Elara refused to succumb to the crushing dark. It is said her final prayer for her companions’ safety didn't just summon light—it tore a fragment of the sun through the firmament, anchoring it to her prayer beads and banishing the primordial shadows forever.
